subject: SI marketplace starter credit request — Sanmar PoC
messages:
From: Nathan Lee <nathan@sanmar.io>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: SI-led marketplace starter credit request for Sanmar PoC

Hi Jasmine / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro last week. Sanmar is preparing a short SI-led proof-of-concept with BrightArc (their systems integrator) to evaluate Redwood for an embedded inference workflow across 3 internal apps. BrightArc will manage the integration and run the initial evaluation in their sandbox environment.

Quick ask: to make the PoC viable for the SI, can Redwood provision an extra starter credit allotment (voucher) and extend the standard 30-day trial window to 60 days? The usage profile will spike the first 2 weeks (heavy generation + embeddings) and then taper. Without additional credits and a little runway the SI can’t demonstrate value to the engineering leads.

I attached the PoC plan (high level) and a preliminary usage estimate. If you need an SI statement of work or a contracting contact at Sanmar I can loop them in.

Requested uplift: $30,000 in trial credit + 60-day extension (provisional, pending policy).

Thanks,
Nathan
Nathan Lee
Head of Integrations, Sanmar Systems
[Attachment: Sanmar_PoC_plan.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: SI-led marketplace starter credit request for Sanmar PoC

Thanks Nathan — appreciate the context and the PoC plan.

Ben / Vanessa — are we able to make an exception for an SI-sourced marketplace trial like this? Key questions:
- Confirm total credit amount requested and whether $30k is gross or co-funded with BrightArc
- Is a 60-day extension allowed under the current marketplace voucher policy (or do we need a one-off approval)
- Any compliance or contractual pre-reqs (PO, MOU) from Sanmar procurement I should expect before activation

Nathan — can you confirm BrightArc’s co-funding (if any) and share the SI statement of work or a short MOU draft?

If it helps, I can provisionally hold a $15k buffer from the partner promo pool while we route approval. Would prefer to avoid blocking the SI.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Partner Sales
Redwood Inference

Jasmine — thanks for flagging. I reviewed the PoC plan. Approve provisional uplift subject to the following gating items:
1) Finance confirmation of the $30k credit as a promoter credit (not a refund liability) — will ask for ledger tag DEV-POP-TRIAL
2) Sanmar signs a short MOU (we can waive a full contract for this pilot) with a clause that credits are for PoC only and expire after the 60-day window
3) BrightArc confirms co-funding or assistance on integration timelines (even a 10% co-fund helps allocation)

I’m comfortable authorizing an initial $15,000 activation now from the partner promo pool so the SI can start. The remaining $15,000 can be released after MOU execution and finance tagging.

HubSpot deal: DEAL-45891 (I’ve added notes and the PoC plan).

Ben Carter
Director, Marketplace Programs

- Timeline: provisional activation within 24 hours of this email; remaining credits after MOU + PO (if procurement requires).
